definitions.window: anchor < step <= anchor+110; anchor69/234 is pre-injection state; first post-step70/235
definitions.planar_motion: signed world root linear velocity xy [m/s]; signed root position xy minus episode reset position [m]
definitions.window_net_displacement: last observed window position minus position at this event's anchor; excludes pre-event drift/prior-push displacement; not necessarily displacement caused only by the push
definitions.peak: maximum planar-speed sample inside observed recovery window, earliest tie; not injected delta-v
definitions.directions: parallel basis is measured injected delta-v for this event; repeated events have separate directions
definitions.conditions: overlap; failed-condition counts do not sum to window steps; dwell stops counting at first latch, condition counts cover whole window

visual.observation: During the sampled post-push sequence the leg configuration and relative foot positions change; late samples show substantial knee flexion and the body lowering. This is visible movement, not evidence of a wholly motionless body.
visual.uncertainty: Replay is a new run. Checkpoint, cell, protocol, outcome, duration and endpoint speed match the archive, but full per-step visual/numeric equivalence was not verified. Single oblique camera, selected montage samples, no contact forces; do not infer exact step count, support timing or reward causation. The terminal step111 itself is not in the 110-frame video. No second push occurs before this termination.

uncertainty: No feet/contact/yaw arrays: cannot infer step counts, support strategy or collision force.
Coarse whole-population statistics and representatives have different denominators; selected examples do not establish prevalence.
Not_recovered includes missed dwell and final instability after successful dwell; endpoint upright is not whole-trajectory upright.
Observed instability does not prove a reward term caused it or that an untrained change will work.
